facts.text: In the tool comparison tables, "Demonstrated" means documented customer, government or peer-reviewed use, or a shipped example.
facts.quote: "Demonstrated" means documented customer, government or peer-reviewed use or a shipped example

facts.text: In the tool comparison tables, "claimed" means a vendor statement only.
In the tool comparison tables, "on-road only" means proven for road vehicles with no off-road evidence found.
facts.quote: "on-road only" means proven for road vehicles with no off-road evidence found

facts.text: In the tool comparison tables, "Not found" represents a finding rather than a gap in the table.
